```yaml
name: CodeQL Analyze Reusable
on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      runner_os:
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ubuntu-latest

permissions:
  actions: read
  contents: read
  security-events: write

jobs:
  analyze:
    runs-on: ${{ inputs.runner_os }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup CodeQL
        uses: github/codeql-action/setup@v3
        with:
          languages: csharp

      - name: Autobuild
        uses: github/codeql-action/autobuild@v3
        with:
          build-mode: autobuild

      - name: Analyze
        uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@v3
        with:
          config: StaticAnalysis
          output: sarif
          upload: true
```
